credits.purpose: This app exists to build statistics muscle memory — the reflexes to read a mean, a p-value, or a confidence interval correctly without stopping to think — and, just as importantly, to practice turning data into visualizations that support leadership decisions.

credits.textbook_note: I have been proud to teach from it across all levels of education since 2011. It is a tribute to my professors in the Department of Educational Psychology at the University of Kansas, where I earned my PhD, and my dissertation advisor, Dr. William Skorupski, who further inspired my love for data. items.q: Which of the two depends on assumptions about how people were selected?

items.q: In statistics, a "population" is:

items.q: A sample is:
